sourceManifest.scope: Literal local import closure of this actual centered numerical source runner, including itself.

premises.sourceFrame: |Ka-K|,|Na-N|,|sa-s|<=B^256/S; all frozen c0/lambda bounds and original sign convention retained.

method.center: a_sign=w_plus_sign(Ls/2)>0; neither a_sign nor w_plus is replaced by1.
method.core: For |x|<=64, |log(P^2)+x^2|<=100*|x|^3/(3*sqrt(g*Ls)). Combine with the scalar center ratio and the invariant cone, then integrate over length128.
method.tail: For |x|>=64 and beta<=1, P^2*(w_plus/a)^2*(1+r)^2<=4*exp(-x^2/6). Both tails are <=24/64*exp(-64^2/6)<(24/64)*2^-682. The reference Gaussian has both tails <=2^-4096/64.
method.exponentBounds: e>2 gives every displayed positive rational tail; no original exponential is set to zero.

proof.quadrant: 0<4*atan(1/5)-atan(1/239)<4/5<pi/2; its tangent is exactly1, so the angle is pi/4.
proof.gaussian: Integral over the whole real line of exp(-x^2) equals sqrt(pi); it follows by nonnegative Fubini and polar coordinates, or DLMF7.2.1/7.2.2 at zero.
proof.squareRoot: Integer floor/ceiling square roots of the dyadic endpoints; no library decimal is used as a bound.

sigmaIntegral.sourceDefinition: sigma(s)=exp(-s^-2)/(exp(-s^-2)+exp(-(1-s)^-2)), with sigma=0 for s<=0 and sigma=1 for s>=1.

proof.endpointTailProof: z(s)=(1-s)^-2-s^-2 is increasing; f<=exp(z); exp(-m)<2^-m for positive integer m.

errorBudget.definition: Absolute width of the normalized sigma-square integral enclosure.
errorBudget.quadratureMeaning: Validated Taylor and omitted-collar contributions, including outward rounding of their derivative enclosures and radii.
errorBudget.arithmeticMeaning: Outward midpoint-jet and polynomial arithmetic plus the explicit elementary exponential-series remainders. No refinement difference is used as a quadrature bound.

elementary.tinyValuePolicy: For x<=-(bits+8), 0<exp(x)<2^(-bits); enclosure [0,2^(-bits)] preserves a positive upper bound.

cutoffIntegral.definition: Absolute width of the normalized sigma-square integral enclosure.
cutoffIntegral.quadratureMeaning: Validated Taylor and omitted-collar contributions, including outward rounding of their derivative enclosures and radii.
cutoffIntegral.arithmeticMeaning: Outward midpoint-jet and polynomial arithmetic plus the explicit elementary exponential-series remainders. No refinement difference is used as a quadrature bound.

errorBudget.tinyErrorPolicy: A nonzero error below one dyadic ulp is rounded up, never set to zero.

derivation.base: All actual source norm summands are positive/nonnegative, hence B>=2^128 and B>=Renv^4096.
derivation.selector: The literal source maximum contains B^512. ell=ceil(max(8,Sminimum,(64/h)^2))+8 is therefore >=B^512, so S=ell^2>=B^1024. No logarithm, ceiling or huge integer is evaluated in binary64.
derivation.margin: The pinned parameter chain has 0<h<1, T>10, Pstar>1, K>1, 0<sigmaStar<1 and the quality parameter Q>2^260. Thus CSelected>2 and Renv=exp(CSelected^25600000)>2^4096; kappa=Renv^-10<2^-40960 and kappa/128<2^-40967.
derivation.curvature: u=2*Renv^10>=2 and Renv^-31<=lambda0<=Renv^83. g=3*lambda0*u^2/(1+u^2)^(3/2) lies between lambda0/u and 3*lambda0/u, hence B^-1<g<B. Therefore g*Ls>=B^1022.
derivation.cone: lambdaFloor=lambdaLower/(2u), coneK=4*B^256/lambdaFloor=8*B^256*u/lambdaLower<B^260. The actual invariant Riccati cone gives |r|<=B^-764 and w_plus>0.
derivation.scalar: In the actual M11=E11-(d-dref), M12=E12, the cone gives |(log w_plus)_v|<=3*B^256/S. After x=(v-Ls/2)*sqrt(g/Ls), beta<=3*B^(256+1/2)/sqrt(S)<B^-254.
derivation.midpointFrame: At v0, s=sign*u and c=c0*sqrt(1+u^2)=-Ac. The actual B columns retain -sa*Ka and +/-c*Na. With |Ka-K|,|Na-N|,|sa-s|<=B^-768, |r|<=B^-764, B^-1<Ac,u<B^2, each normalized radial, normal or signed tangent center component differs from1 by <8*B^-763<2^-8192.
derivation.solution: All inequalities apply to the full original Volterra solutions. No finite sum, unit amplitude, constant coefficient ODE, or Gaussian limit is substituted.

cancellation.arithmetic: Exact BigInt rational functions of the retained actual source operands, with explicit denominator clearing.

endpointIdentity.operations: Bound integral alpha renaming and exact additive/multiplicative regrouping only.

heightIdentity.operations: Bound integral alpha renaming and exact additive/multiplicative regrouping only.

derivation.axial: The private moment-completed global U/M/V are identically zero after their actual Xv. Heat changes E only. The selected witness is after Xplus>Xv and before Xb, so the original leading slow G and all its local slow derivatives vanish. This uses the full moment equations; a compact integrand alone does not annihilate a primitive.
derivation.normal: The same source closed-annulus shear proof has -R*F_R/F>0, and F>0. With G_R=0 and R>0, g0=(R*F_R,0) has negative first component. The original normalization therefore gives N=(-1,0), K=(0,-1). These are analytic consequences of the retained full bodies, not numerical substitutions into the graph.
derivation.target: The original backward outer stress identity, derived with the full heat and moment restoration, is exp(-4/delta^2)*delta^-3*(b_theta,delta^6*b_z). Its actual copied b_z contains the explicit eta factor and becomes exactly0 at eta=0; b_theta>0 by the source outer direction proof. The physical chart factor is1 at s=1. Thus actual T_z=0,T_theta>0 and tau=T_theta/Ac>0.
derivation.inverse: The same frozen N,K and target are used in C. Hence at this witness C*(mass_sign*y_sign/tau)=(1,0), with the source C entry error <=kappa/128. No external target or inverse matrix is supplied.

proof.centeredSolution: a_sign=w_plus_sign(v0)>0 is the same full source solution at v0=Ls/2. Write t=a_sign*t_tilde and H_sign=a_sign^2*H_tilde_sign. H*y=T gives y_tilde_sign=a_sign^2*y_sign. Positive square-root multiplicativity then gives sqrt(y_sign)*t_sign=sqrt(y_tilde_sign)*t_tilde_sign.

proof.mass: For x=(v-v0)*sqrt(g/Ls), the full normalized longitudinal integral d_sign=Integral psi^2*P^2*(w_plus/a_sign)^2*(1+r)^2 dx differs from sqrt(pi) by less than2^-640. Original finite endpoints and nonconstant coefficients are included in the bound.
proof.exactHaar: The literal identity haar*Ls=Dgeom*r0*Integral chi^2, the source chi reduction Integral chi^2=r0*(1/2+I), and sqrt(Ls/g)*sqrt(g*Ls)=Ls give mass_sign=a_sign^2*r0^2/sqrt(g*Ls) * Dgeom*(1/2+I)*d_sign.
proof.exactScales: Every square root uses a strictly positive actual scale. Define A0=sqrt(tau)*(g*Ls)^(1/4)/r0. At v0 the actual weighted radial component/A0, the normal projection/(Ac*A0), and signed tangent projection/(u*A0) lie in the reported positive rational intervals. The original center amplitude cancels algebraically. tau,g,Ls remain exact unevaluated source factors.
proof.numerical: Machin alternating rational series and integer outward square roots give sqrt(pi); the original sigma-square integral uses whole-cell eighth derivative Taylor remainders and nonzero endpoint tails. All inverse/sqrt operations use directed intervals whose denominators and positive inputs exclude zero. Each resulting coefficient width is checked against the exact requested tolerance.
proof.limitations: The absolute mass/H entries retain a_sign^2, and absolute weights retain its reciprocal. No unscaled high-relative-precision values of these quantities or of tau,g,Ls are asserted. This construction encloses values at one original witness and its pulse center; it does not numerically enclose the full slow/fast jets or curl.
